# Veriqo

Veriqo is UK private-chef business software combining HACCP records, bookings, menus, costing, quotes, invoices, payments and prep lists in one connected app. It is built for private chefs and mobile caterers who work in clients' kitchens rather than a fixed restaurant.

- Homepage: https://getveriqo.co.uk
- App: https://getveriqo.co.uk/app
- About: https://getveriqo.co.uk/about
- Contact: https://getveriqo.co.uk/contact  (hello@getveriqo.co.uk)
- Operated by: Side Order Catering Ltd (United Kingdom)
- Founder / author of guides: Michael O'Gorman, MIH — professional chef — https://getveriqo.co.uk/about/michael-ogorman

## Modules

Veriqo is one app made up of connected modules that share a single dish library and job record:

### HACCP — https://getveriqo.co.uk/haccp
Digital food-safety records for UK private chefs. Fridge and freezer temperature logs, cooking/cooling/reheating records, delivery and transport temperature logs, cleaning and disinfection records, opening and closing checklists, allergen declarations, pest control logs, staff illness and injury records, staff credential and certificate tracking with expiry warnings, approved supplier register. EHO-ready PDF and CSV exports. Default thresholds are based on Food Standards Agency guidance and can be adjusted; for example the cooking check defaults to 75°C as an operational limit, and FSA guidance also recognises equivalent time/temperature combinations (such as 70°C for 2 minutes).

### Menus — https://getveriqo.co.uk/menus
Private chef booking and menu management. Job and client records, dish library (name, course, description, allergens, prep tasks), client dietary and allergen tracking, job notes and transport log. The shared dish library feeds HACCP, Costing and Prep Lists.

### Costing — https://getveriqo.co.uk/costing
Private chef job costing, quotes and invoices. Ingredient costing per dish, margin calculator, professional quote generation, invoicing from completed jobs, job profitability tracking, ingredient yield tracking, and card payments via Stripe with funds paid directly to the chef.

### Prep Lists — https://getveriqo.co.uk/prep-lists
Prep lists auto-generated from the Menus dish library, split into prep-ahead and finishing tasks, grouped by course, tickable from a phone in the kitchen. Works offline.

## Pricing

- Starter — £7/month: HACCP module only (food-safety records, allergen records, EHO-ready exports).
- Pro — £15/month: Everything in Starter, plus Menus, Costing and Prep Lists, with data shared across all modules.
- 14-day free trial, no credit card required, cancel any time.

Veriqo is designed around UK food-safety requirements, including the record-keeping expectations of the Food Standards Agency's Safer Food, Better Business guidance for caterers. It is not a certification and does not guarantee compliance on its own.

## Guides

Practical, chef-written guides for private chefs at https://getveriqo.co.uk/resources — covering HACCP compliance, EHO inspections, allergen management, food business registration, and pricing and profit. Written by Michael O'Gorman, MIH.

Veriqo is installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on iPhone and Android.
